caption: The video captures an outdoor concrete patio with a vertical expansion seam, a brick edge on the right, two black tripod legs at the top, and a pale trouser leg with a dark sneaker on the left. A Spalding/NBA basketball hangs in mid-air near the center while a blurred hand is already at the top edge with two fingers extended. As the clip unfolds the ball drifts upward, growing slightly larger, its seams and lettering shift orientation gradually. The descending hand becomes more distinct, the fingers splaying open. The gap between hand and ball closes steadily, the spread fingers overlapping the upper surface as the two converge. The pavement, seam, brick edge, tripod legs, and shoe stay steady, indicating the motion is the ball and hand relative to the camera.
